correctness.rationale: Affine barycentric coordinates λ_i with ∑λ_i X_i=0 and ∑λ_i=1 satisfy: facet opposite i strictly separates 0 iff λ_i<0. Three negative coordinates would write the lone positive boundary vertex as a strict convex combination of 0 (interior to K) with other boundary vertices, contradicting being on ∂K; therefore V<=2. Conditional on four unoriented sample lines, independent antipodally symmetric laws supply 16 equiprobable orientation signs. Their unique linear-dependence coefficients a_i=ε_i b_i have nonzero sum almost surely and λ_i=a_i/∑a. The 2 all-same signs yield V0, eight 1-versus-3 signs yield V1 by boundary restriction, six balanced signs yield V2. This proves exact probabilities 1/8,1/2,3/8 for arbitrary independent nonidentical plane-null antipodal boundary measures. Atoms/coplanar degeneracies excluded by hypothesis, no interior-sampling extension claimed.
